question: A policeman and a thief start from the same place and walk at the rate of 5 km/h and 5.5 km/h, respectively. How much time will they take to be 9.5 km apart, if they walk in the same direction?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (same direction) = Speed difference

⇒ Relative speed = 5.5 − 5 = 0.5 km/h

⇒ Time required = Distance ÷ Relative speed

⇒ Time = 9.5 ÷ 0.5 = 19 hrs

**∴ The correct answer is 19 hrs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Policeman = 5 km/h

Speed of Thief = 5.5 km/h

Target distance apart = 9.5 km

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = Speed₁ − Speed₂

Time = Distance ÷ Speed
